name: Pipeline Diagram Component
description: Custom React/SVG component for the Home page showing the exemplar.tools pipeline flow. Renders step boxes (Step 0 through Step 7) connected by arrows/lines in the correct order, with branching for parallel steps (1a/1b, 2a/2b, 5a/5b/5c). Each box is clickable and navigates to the corresponding step page via React Router. Responsive sizing. Named export PipelineDiagram. Tests verify all step nodes render and click navigation.

functions.name: PipelineDiagram
functions.description: React functional component that renders the pipeline DAG as an interactive SVG diagram. Renders 12 step nodes (Step 0 through Step 7 including parallel branches 1a/1b, 2a/2b, 5a/5b/5c) connected by 14 directed edges. Each node is an accessible, clickable SVG group (<g>) containing a rect and text. Clicking a node navigates to the corresponding step page. The SVG uses a fixed viewBox with width='100%' and preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' for responsive sizing. Keyboard accessible via tabIndex and Enter/Space key handlers.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props. All fields optional; defaults to internal constants and useNavigate.

error_cases.name: missing_router_context
error_cases.condition: Component is rendered outside a React Router context and onNodeClick prop is not provided.

error_data.message: useNavigate() may be used only in the context of a <Router> component.

error_cases.name: invalid_edge_reference
error_cases.condition: An edge references a stepId not present in the nodes array.

error_data.message: Edge references unknown stepId; the edge will not be rendered.

preconditions: Component must be rendered within a React Router context (e.g. BrowserRouter or MemoryRouter) if onNodeClick is not provided, because useNavigate requires router context.
If nodes are provided, each node.slug must be a valid RouteSlug.
If edges are provided, each edge.from and edge.to must reference a stepId present in the nodes array.
postconditions: Returned SVG element contains exactly nodes.length clickable node groups, each with role='link', tabIndex=0, and an aria-label of the form 'Navigate to {label}'.
Returned SVG element contains exactly edges.length line or path elements connecting the corresponding node pairs.
SVG root element has viewBox='0 0 1200 800', width='100%', and preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet'.
Each node group's onClick handler applies the slug guard before navigating: slug.startsWith('/') ? slug : '/' + slug.
Each node group responds to Enter and Space keydown events identically to click.
If className prop is provided, it is applied to the root SVG element's class attribute.

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function. Navigation side effect occurs only when user clicks a node, handled by the onClick callback.

performance_budget.complexity: O(n + e) where n = number of nodes, e = number of edges

functions.name: guardSlug
functions.description: Normalizes a slug string to guarantee it starts with a leading '/'. Implements the project-standard slug guard: slug.startsWith('/') ? slug : '/' + slug. This is a pure utility function used internally by PipelineDiagram before any navigation call.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: The raw slug string to normalize. May or may not start with '/'.

validators.error_message: Slug must be between 1 and 64 characters.

preconditions: slug must be a non-empty string.
postconditions: Returned string always starts with exactly one '/'.
If input already starts with '/', the output is identical to the input.
If input does not start with '/', the output is '/' prepended to the input.
No double-slash '//' prefix is introduced when input already starts with '/'.

structured_side_effects.description: Pure function with no side effects.

functions.name: PIPELINE_NODES
functions.description: Module-level constant: an array of 12 DiagramNode objects representing all pipeline steps excluding 'home'. Each node has a stepId, label, slug, and x/y viewBox coordinates for layout. Steps: step-0, step-1a, step-1b, step-2a, step-2b, step-3, step-4, step-5a, step-5b, step-5c, step-6, step-7. Exported as a named constant.
postconditions: Array contains exactly 12 DiagramNode elements.
No node has stepId 'home'.
All stepIds are unique within the array.
All slugs start with '/' (pre-guarded from ROUTE_SLUG_MAP).
All x values are within [0, 1200] and all y values are within [0, 800].

functions.name: PIPELINE_EDGES
functions.description: Module-level constant: an array of 14 PipelineEdge objects defining the complete DAG topology. Edges: step-0→step-1a, step-0→step-1b, step-1a→step-2a, step-1b→step-2b, step-2a→step-3, step-2b→step-3, step-3→step-4, step-4→step-5a, step-4→step-5b, step-4→step-5c, step-5a→step-6, step-5b→step-6, step-5c→step-6, step-6→step-7. Exported as a named constant.
postconditions: Array contains exactly 14 PipelineEdge elements.
All 'from' and 'to' stepIds reference steps present in PIPELINE_NODES.
The edge set forms a valid directed acyclic graph (DAG) with no cycles.
step-0 is the sole root node (no incoming edges).
step-7 is the sole terminal node (no outgoing edges).

invariants: PIPELINE_NODES always contains exactly 12 nodes, one for each step: step-0, step-1a, step-1b, step-2a, step-2b, step-3, step-4, step-5a, step-5b, step-5c, step-6, step-7.
PIPELINE_EDGES always contains exactly 14 directed edges modeling the DAG: 0→1a, 0→1b, 1a→2a, 1b→2b, 2a→3, 2b→3, 3→4, 4→5a, 4→5b, 4→5c, 5a→6, 5b→6, 5c→6, 6→7.
Every edge in PIPELINE_EDGES references stepIds that exist in PIPELINE_NODES.
The slug guard (slug.startsWith('/') ? slug : '/' + slug) is always applied before any navigation call, preventing double-slash prefixes.
All exports are named exports only — no default exports.
The SVG viewBox is always '0 0 1200 800' and the SVG root is always responsive (width='100%', preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet').
Every rendered node group has role='link', tabIndex=0, and aria-label='Navigate to {label}' for accessibility.
Keyboard interaction (Enter and Space) on a node triggers the same navigation as a mouse click.
The component never prepends an extra '/' to a slug that already starts with '/'.

Module exports exactly: PipelineDiagram, PIPELINE_NODES, PIPELINE_EDGES, guardSlug as runtime values; PipelineDiagramProps, PipelineEdge, PipelineEdgeList, DiagramNode, DiagramNodeList as type-only exports.

data_access.rationale: Reads public pipeline step metadata (stepId, label, slug) from step_content and route_config modules to render the diagram. No PII or sensitive data is accessed. The component writes nothing; it only renders UI and triggers client-side navigation.

side_effects.rationale: On node click, the component calls React Router useNavigate with the step's RouteSlug to perform client-side navigation to the corresponding step page.

authority.rationale: This component is the single authoritative source for the pipeline DAG edge topology (PIPELINE_EDGES) and the spatial layout coordinates (x, y positions within the SVG viewBox) used to render the pipeline diagram. Node identity data (stepId, label, slug) is imported from step_content and route_config, but the edge connections and visual positions are owned here.
